run_metadata.coverage_summary: Swept all nine Tier-1 government portals (AusTender, buy.nsw/NSW eTendering, Buying for Victoria, QTenders, Tenders WA, Tenders SA, Tenders Tasmania, NT QTOL, ACT Tenders) plus VendorPanel and the mandatory Tier-3 channel (SAP Ariba Discovery) via web search. Direct page fetching was blocked environment-wide (HTTP 403 anti-bot walls) on every government portal and on individual AusTender ATM detail pages, so opportunity detail could only be captured from search-index snippets, not from the buyers' own detail pages or tender documents. Genuinely new opportunities surfaced this run were in Tasmania (City of Hobart, City of Launceston). Most other recent items resurfaced by search were already recorded in prior runs. Tier-3 corporate channels were checked and remain registration- or invitation-gated with no publicly-visible RFx; recorded as a portal, not fabricated as tenders.
gaps: WebFetch returned HTTP 403 (Forbidden) for the Tier-1 portal landing/search pages: https://www.tenders.gov.au/atm, https://www.tenders.nsw.gov.au, https://www.tenders.vic.gov.au/tenders/open, https://www.vendorpanel.com.au/publictenders.aspx. Portals appear to enforce anti-bot protection against non-browser clients in this environment.

Individual AusTender ATM detail pages (e.g. https://www.tenders.gov.au/Atm/Show/...) and the Buying for Victoria tender view page (https://www.tenders.vic.gov.au/tender/view?id=251016) also returned HTTP 403, so full deliverables/requirements/contact extraction from buyer detail pages and tender documents was not possible this run. Detail below is limited to what public search snippets exposed and is marked pending verification.

Tenders WA, QTenders (QLD), Tenders SA, NT QTOL and ACT Tenders were reachable only via search-index summaries; no new jurisdiction-specific opportunities could be confirmed at detail level beyond items already known from prior runs.

Tier-3 (SAP Ariba Discovery, BHP, Rio Tinto, Woolworths, Coles, Qantas, banks, telcos): no publicly-visible RFx surfaced without login. These channels are registration-gated (Ariba/Coupa) or invitation-only; per spec the portal is recorded in discovered_sources and no corporate opportunities were invented.
Invitation-only management-consultancy RFPs (Accenture/KPMG/Deloitte-style) are out of scope by definition (never published) and were not sought as tenders.
